traps: Southwest's old bag simplicity is gone: Basic, Choice, and Choice Preferred now have standard checked-bag fees in the published 2026 structure, while Choice Extra keeps the first two bags free.
unique_insights.pro_hack: If you are checking bags on Southwest, compare the bag fees against the fare upgrade. Choice Extra can be rational when the first two checked bags would otherwise be paid.
